title: Duck triggered while muted freezes mid-envelope and lands as an audible dip right after unmute
detail: Trigger has no muted guard; bed_update skips while muted, freezing the envelope; the reset runs only when muting. A duck staged during mute (flush still fires on pending plays) survives frozen and plays out after unmute, contradicting 'unmute lands at the normal level'.
recommended_fix: Guard bed_duck_trigger on a.muted (or skip the flush trigger while muted), or reset the envelope on unmute too, so a during-mute event burst cannot duck the just-resumed bed.

title: PR body claims '17/17 (13 pre-existing + 4 new bed tests)' but the diff adds seven new bed tests
detail: Seven @(test) procs are added in audio_test.odin; 13+7=20, not 17. The PR body's verification line (and its '17 audio unit tests' decision note) is stale relative to the shipped suite — written before the r1 folds landed.
recommended_fix: Regenerate the PR body's test numbers from the final suite (20 total, 7 new) so the verification section matches the diff a reviewer can count.

title: Device-gate claims for the bed are asserted everywhere but implemented nowhere in the added code
evidence:
+	a.bed = load_bed()
+	if a.bed.frameCount > 0 {
+		a.bed_on = true
...
+	// app-owned duck envelope. `bed_on` mirrors the device/asset gate (no
+	// device or an undecodable file = no bed, silently).
...
+- **Headless/CI-safe:** bed load + play gate on `IsAudioDeviceReady()` (the #81 silent-fallback precedent); a missing/undecodable OGG prints one stderr note and the game plays exactly as before.
detail: audio_init sets bed_on purely on frameCount > 0; no device_on term appears in any added line. The hunk comment, struct comment, spec NO_DEVICE row, and PR body all promise a device gate — true only if deviceless LoadMusicStream happens to yield frameCount 0.
recommended_fix: Make the gate explicit: skip load_bed when !a.device_on and set bed_on only under a.device_on, so the headless contract is enforced in code rather than by raylib failure behavior.

title: test_bed_duck_never_raises cannot fail at the shipped constants — cap removal goes undetected
evidence:
+MUSIC_VOLUME :: f32(0.40)
...
+MUSIC_DUCK_VOLUME :: f32(0.12)
...
+	duck_ratio := min(MUSIC_DUCK_VOLUME / MUSIC_VOLUME, 1.0)
...
+	testing.expectf(t, bed_duck_multiplier(&a) <= 1.0,
+		"duck multiplier %v exceeds 1.0 (would raise the bed)", bed_duck_multiplier(&a))
detail: At shipped constants the uncapped ratio is 0.3, so both assertions (multiplier ≤ 1.0, ducked level ≤ master) pass with or without the min cap. Deleting the cap keeps every test green until MUSIC_VOLUME is retuned at/below MUSIC_DUCK_VOLUME.
recommended_fix: Make the cap load-bearing in a test: parameterize bed_duck_multiplier/bed_level over master and duck volumes (pure inputs) so a test can drive the master-below-duck case directly.

title: pending_any_plays comment claims the flush's play loops key off it; they do not
evidence:
+// pending_any_plays — the ONE place that knows the play-family list (r1
+// review note 7): any staged play in the flush's Pending. The duck trigger
+// and (implicitly) the flush's play loops both key off it.
...
 		v := (a.pending.spawn_variant + i32(k)) % SPAWN_VARIANTS
 		rl.PlaySound(a.spawn[v])
detail: The comment's single-source claim is hedged with '(implicitly)' because the play loops still iterate their own per-family counts. A fifth family added later still requires editing both the loops and the helper — the silent-miss hazard the fold claimed to close remains.
recommended_fix: Reword the comment to state the helper covers only the duck trigger, or genuinely derive the flush's play iteration from one family table so the single-source claim is true.

title: Committed review-diff.txt embeds the pre-fold code, contradicting the shipped hunks in the same commit
evidence:
++	duck_ratio := MUSIC_DUCK_VOLUME / MUSIC_VOLUME
...
++// soft-lower × the duck multiplier. SetMusicVolume clamps at 1.0 in raylib
++// (the duck floor stays MUSIC_DUCK_VOLUME absolute even when the master
++// sits below it — the tunable scales the normal level, never the duck's
++// audibility floor). PURE — unit-tested headless.
...
+	duck_ratio := min(MUSIC_DUCK_VOLUME / MUSIC_VOLUME, 1.0)
...
+🔌 MCP: 2 servers enabled
detail: review-diff.txt (header: 'Diff vs baseline 339e173 (tracked)') ships the uncapped multiplier and the retracted absolute-floor comment alongside the fixed code in the same commit, and the review .txt files are raw session transcripts with terminal chrome. Only verif-gap.txt's own aside flags the staleness.
recommended_fix: Label the artifact explicitly as the pre-r1 review snapshot in its header (or file it under a dated review-round directory) and strip session chrome, so it cannot be mistaken for the current diff.

title: PR-body scratch file committed at the repository root
evidence:
diff --git a/_pr_body_ambience.md b/_pr_body_ambience.md
new file mode 100644
detail: An underscore-prefixed working artifact lands at the repo root while the same diff's .gitignore excludes comparable scratch (_bmad-output/**/review/_charter-*.md, .pp-settings.bin). The naming pattern signals 'do not commit'; nothing else at root follows it.
recommended_fix: Drop the file from the commit (PR bodies live in the PR), or move it under _bmad-output/ if a committed record is wanted; optionally add a _pr_body_*.md ignore rule.
